## Pull Request Review Requirements

**This is a private repository with strict access control.**

### For External Contributors

External PRs are ONLY accepted if they fix serious/critical issues. Read below carefully:

**Accepted contributions:**
- ✅ Security vulnerability fixes
- ✅ Critical bug fixes (app crashes, data loss, breaking errors)
- ✅ Well-documented, high-quality code

**Rejected contributions:**
- ❌ Layout/design changes without approval
- ❌ Feature requests or enhancements
- ❌ Code style refactoring
- ❌ UI/UX changes
- ❌ Anything that changes "what the owner wants"

**ALL PRs require explicit approval from @Nickog47 before merging.**

### Checklist

- [ ] I have NOT changed layout, styling, or core functionality without approval
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have tested these changes thoroughly
- [ ] I have provided clear documentation of the issue and solution
- [ ] I understand this requires owner approval before merging
